scope: Independent transcript provenance and exact original Cerfon citation; no new full-text original-paper coverage and no mathematical-claim changes.

transcript.method: Read-only DOM extraction of the visible timestamps and text from all 249 timed entries in the public YouTube Show transcript panel; separately generated from the browser export attempt.
transcript.last_timestamp_semantics: Start of the final exposed transcript entry, not the video end time.
transcript.canonicalization: UTF-8 without BOM; each line is the visible timestamp, TAB, trimmed textContent, and LF. Internal transcript spelling and punctuation are preserved.

export_tool_attempt.path_verification: The returned path could not be opened in the browser runtime (ENOENT). It is not counted as verified exporter output.

limitations: No full audiovisual review is claimed.
The source captions are not certified as error-free or author-authored.
The content hash identifies the extracted bytes reviewed; it does not independently validate their scientific claims.
The full transcript is privately cached and is not redistributed in the repository or release artifacts.
The earlier caption-file and transcript-API failures remain historical evidence; those endpoints were not reattempted in this continuation.

cerfon_citation.method: Read the destination of the Cerfon link in the original video expanded bibliography.
cerfon_citation.conclusion: The historical attempted URL matches the original citation. This confirmation does not close the notes-access gap.
